create_marian_config: create a MarianConfig instance with default transformer model configuration parameters
configure_marian_encoder: configure MarianConfig encoder layers, attention heads, and feed-forward dimensions
configure_marian_decoder: configure MarianConfig decoder layers, attention heads, and feed-forward dimensions
initialize_marian_model: initialize a MarianModel with a MarianConfig for Helsinki-NLP opus-mt-en-de style translation
customize_marian_embeddings: customize MarianConfig vocab size, decoder vocab size, and shared encoder-decoder embeddings
